  "rationales": {"U":"需求文本使用模糊短语'A listing'和'>Need to determine extent...'，后者为待办事项而非需求陈述，缺乏主语、动词和验收边界；读者无法理解该条目是系统功能、数据输出还是调研任务。证据片段：'A listing of the computer science offerings...'和'>Need to determine extent of community and private colleges in Oregon'。",
  "A":"'Oregon university System campuses and other Oregon colleges'存在术语歧义：'Oregon university System'拼写错误（应为'University'），且未定义'other Oregon colleges'是否包含已列出的系统内院校或仅指非系统院校；'offerings'未明确是课程、学位、专业方向还是在线资源。证据片段：'Oregon university System campuses and other Oregon colleges'。",
  "C":"需求隐含数据范围断言（即存在一个确定的'listing'），但未验证Oregon是否存在统一的'University System'实体——实际为'Oregon University System'已于2015年解散，现由'Oregon Student Assistance Commission'和各独立大学管理；因此该需求基于过时/错误事实。证据片段：'Oregon university System campuses'。",
  "V":"无可观测行为、输出格式、数据粒度、更新频率或成功判定标准；'listing'未说明是网页表格、API响应、PDF下载或数据库视图；'extent'不可测量。证据片段：'A listing...'和'>Need to determine extent...'"},
  "suggestions": {"U":"The system shall display a publicly accessible web page listing all undergraduate and graduate computer science degree programs (including majors, minors, and certificates) currently offered by institutions accredited in Oregon.",
  "A":"The system shall display a web page listing all undergraduate and graduate computer science degree programs (majors, minors, and certificates) offered as of the current academic year by: (a) the seven public universities under the Oregon State Board of Higher Education (e.g., University of Oregon, Oregon State University), and (b) all non-profit, regionally accredited private and community colleges headquartered in Oregon.",
  "C":"The system shall display a web page listing all undergraduate and graduate computer science degree programs (majors, minors, and certificates) offered as of the current academic year by: (a) the seven public universities under the Oregon State Board of Higher Education (e.g., University of Oregon, Oregon State University), and (b) all non-profit, regionally accredited private and community colleges headquartered in Oregon.",
  "V":"The system shall generate a HTML page at /programs/computer-science that contains a sortable table with columns: Institution Name (string), Institution Type (enum: 'public-university' | 'community-college' | 'private-college'), Program Name (string), Program Level (enum: 'bachelor' | 'master' | 'doctorate' | 'certificate' | 'minor'), and CIP Code (string, format: '11.0701'). The table shall contain exactly one row per distinct program-institution combination, and shall be regenerated daily from source data validated against the U.S. Department of Education IPEDS database."},
